stories.title: Meta 为 Muse AI 智能体打造独立硬件 Muse Charm
stories.sourceTitle: Meta is making a standalone Muse AI gadget
stories.summary: Meta 正在为旗下新 AI 智能体 Muse 开发专用硬件设备，代号 Muse Charm，CEO 扎克伯格在 Meta Connect 发布会尾声短暂展示了它，外形接近一块没有表带的厚重智能手表。这意味着 Meta 想把 AI 智能体从手机和眼镜里独立出来，做成一个随身常驻的入口。
stories.analysis: 硬件是 Meta 给 Muse 找的“物理存在感”，但真正决定成败的是智能体能否脱离手机独立完成有价值的任务。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Meta is building a dedicated hardware device for its new Muse AI agent. The product, called Muse Charm, was briefly shown off by Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg at the end of tonight's Meta Connect presentation. It looks almost like a chunky smartwatch without the st

stories.title: Meta 宣布把 Muse 智能体接入智能眼镜，喊名字即可唤醒
stories.sourceTitle: Muse is coming to Meta smart glasses
stories.summary: 在推出 Muse 仅两周后，Meta 表示正在把该智能体引入自家智能眼镜，包括在 Meta Connect 上新发布的眼镜。用户只要说出 Muse 的名字就能激活并直接提问。
stories.analysis: 眼镜是 Muse 最自然的载体，但语音唤醒能否在公共场合被接受，决定了它会不会沦为演示功能。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Just a couple of weeks after launching Muse, Meta announced that it's "working on" bringing the agent to its smart glasses, including the new glasses it unveiled at Meta Connect. Users will be able to activate Muse from their glasses by saying its name and ask

stories.title: Meta 最新智能眼镜去掉摄像头，回应可穿戴监控争议
stories.sourceTitle: Meta ditches the camera on its newest smart glasses
stories.summary: Meta 在新款智能眼镜上取消了摄像头配置。原文提到会场外公众对可穿戴监控设备的反弹持续升温，而这款无摄像头眼镜更轻、续航最长可达 12 小时。
stories.analysis: 去掉摄像头是 Meta 在隐私舆论压力下的主动让步，也说明智能眼镜的普及瓶颈不只是技术。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Walking around Meta Connect 2026, everyone's sporting smart glasses in all sorts of shapes, colors, and sizes. It's a marked difference here, a tech bubble where "pervert glasses" are not a concern. Outside Connect, the public backlash against wearable surveil

stories.title: Meta 给 Muse 智能体发邮箱地址，还支持视频通话
stories.sourceTitle: Meta is making Muse more powerful and will let you video chat with it, too
stories.summary: Meta 宣布 Muse 智能体的一批更新：每个智能体将拥有自己的电子邮箱用于完成任务，用户还能与它进行视频通话，交互方式进一步扩展。
stories.analysis: 给智能体配邮箱是把“代理”变成“可被外部系统联系的主体”，权限与责任边界会随之变得棘手。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Meta is quickly iterating on its new Muse AI agent, announcing a bunch of updates today that make the bot more capable and able to chat with you in more ways. Muse agents are getting their own email addresses that they can use for accomplishing tasks. You'll a

stories.title: Meta Connect 2026 全部看点汇总：Muse 智能体与智能眼镜成主线
stories.sourceTitle: Meta Connect 2026: The biggest news and announcements
stories.summary: The Verge 汇总了 Meta 年度发布会 Meta Connect 2026 的主要发布内容。今年公司重点押注 AI 与智能眼镜等可穿戴设备，扎克伯格及其团队围绕这些品类公布更新。
stories.analysis: 从今年发布会的密度看，Meta 已经把可穿戴当成了 AI 落地的第一战场，而不是手机应用的附庸。
stories.sourceExcerpt: It’s about time for Meta Connect, the company’s annual product launch event. This year, given the company’s major focus on AI and wearables like smart glasses, it seems likely that we’ll see updates from CEO Mark Zuckerberg and his team on those categories. Th

stories.title: 加州签署数据中心透明化法案，要求披露电费与水资源影响
stories.sourceTitle: Data centers are black boxes, but California wants to change that
stories.summary: 加州州长 Gavin Newsom 签署一揽子法案，让社区能获得更多数据、并在数据中心如何影响当地电费和水供应的问题上有更多发言权。随着数据中心进入越来越多社区，这一问题正变得敏感。
stories.analysis: 数据中心的地方成本长期由居民承担、收益由企业获取，加州此举可能成为其他州监管的模板。
stories.sourceExcerpt: California Gov. Gavin Newsom signed a slate of bills on Monday that could finally give communities better data - and more say - on how data centers impact their electricity bills and water supply. As data centers invade a growing number of communities across t

stories.title: Meta Connect 2026 现场直播：扎克伯格发布会的实时追踪
stories.sourceTitle: Meta Connect 2026 live blog: On the ground at Mark Zuckerberg’s next big product launch
stories.summary: The Verge 团队在门洛帕克现场直播 Meta 年度 9 月产品发布会。官方称扎克伯格的主旨演讲主题是“Meta 正在为所有人构建未来”，直播内容持续更新。
stories.analysis: 这类现场直播的价值在于捕捉官方口径与演示实际效果之间的落差。
stories.sourceExcerpt: It's time once again for Meta's annual September product launch event, and The Verge is on the ground in Menlo Park to cover the show live. Meta says that today's keynote by Mark Zuckerberg will be about how "Meta is building a future for everyone" - something

stories.title: Anthropic 生物实验室迎来首个成果：Claude 自主发现类 CRISPR 酶系统
stories.sourceTitle: Anthropic’s biolab made a discovery it’s comparing to Crispr
stories.summary: Anthropic 称其 AI Claude “自主发现”了一种新的酶系统，类似基因编辑工具 CRISPR 背后的机制。这是 Anthropic 新设湿实验室的首个成果，也是对 Claude 科研实用性的早期检验。
stories.analysis: 如果结论可复现，这将是 AI 从“辅助写论文”跨向“提出可验证生物学假设”的关键一步。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Anthropic says its AI Claude has "autonomously discovered" a new enzyme system similar to machinery behind the powerful gene-editing tool Crispr. It's the first result from Anthropic's newly-launched wet lab and an early test of Claude's usefulness for science

stories.title: TechCrunch 盘点：Meta 智能体 Muse 将迎来的所有新功能
stories.sourceTitle: Everything new coming to Meta’s AI agent Muse
stories.summary: 扎克伯格在门洛帕克年度 Connect 大会的主题演讲中明确表示 Meta 将全力押注 Muse，并称该智能体还会进入 Meta 的 AI 眼镜。TechCrunch 梳理了围绕 Muse 的全部新进展。
stories.analysis: “全力押注”意味着 Muse 的表现将直接决定 Meta 硬件与 AI 两条线的叙事能否成立。
stories.sourceExcerpt: CEO Mark Zuckerberg kicked off the company’s annual Connect event in Menlo Park on Wednesday with a keynote that made one thing clear: Meta is going all-in on Muse. It's even coming to Meta's AI glasses.

stories.title: Meta 为 Muse 智能体做了一款类似 Tamagotchi 的随身小硬件
stories.sourceTitle: Meta made a Tamagotchi-like wearable for its Muse AI agent
stories.summary: 这款小型硬件设备为 AI 智能体 Muse 提供了又一个移动端的“住所”。与其他设备一样，它把 Muse 从软件形态变成可以随身携带的实体。
stories.analysis: Tamagotchi 式的拟物化设计很讨巧，但也容易让人低估背后持续的云端与权限成本。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The tiny hardware device creates another mobile home for its AI agent Muse.

stories.title: 伯尼·桑德斯提出立法：禁止开发“超级智能”，违者入狱
stories.sourceTitle: Bernie Sanders proposes banning ‘superintelligence’ and putting violators in prison
stories.summary: 参议员 Bernie Sanders 与众议员 Greg Casar 共同提出新法案，禁止任何人开发人工超级智能。法案将其描述为具备“毁灭或剥夺人类能力”的技术，并规定对违规者追究刑事责任。
stories.analysis: 把超级智能直接列为非法，比此前的透明度与安全评估路线激进得多，但它也几乎无法定义边界。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Sen. Bernie Sanders (I-VT) and Rep. Greg Casar (D-TX) have introduced new legislation that would ban anyone from developing artificial superintelligence - a technology the bill describes as capable of the "destruction or disempowerment of humanity," including

stories.title: Meta 发布无摄像头 AI 眼镜：更轻、续航最长 12 小时
stories.sourceTitle: Meta introduces camera-free AI glasses
stories.summary: Meta 推出不带摄像头的 AI 眼镜，官方称其重量更轻，电池续航最长可达 12 小时。这款产品的定位明显区别于此前带有拍摄能力的型号。
stories.analysis: 砍掉摄像头换取佩戴舒适与公众接受度，是 Meta 在智能眼镜品类上一次务实的取舍。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Meta says the camera-free glasses will be lighter and have up to 12 hours battery life.

stories.title: OpenAI Academy 成立两周年：把 AI 技能培训带到更多社区
stories.sourceTitle: Two years of OpenAI Academy
stories.summary: OpenAI 发文纪念 OpenAI Academy 上线两年，并介绍了该项目继续向更多社区普及 AI 技能的进展。
stories.analysis: 教育项目既是公益叙事，也是培养未来 API 用户和开发者生态的长期投资。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Marking two years of OpenAI Academy and bringing AI skills to even more communities.

stories.title: Anthropic 称其实验室已有重大发现，但人类仍在回路中
stories.sourceTitle: Anthropic says its biology lab has already found something big
stories.summary: TechCrunch 报道指出，Anthropic 生物实验室最重要的信息或许是：他们并没有让 Claude 在实验室里完全自主运行，目前仍由人类把关。
stories.analysis: 同一个发现，Anthropic 强调“自主”，TechCrunch 强调“人类在环”，这种措辞差异本身就值得注意。
stories.sourceExcerpt: But maybe the biggest reveal is that Anthropic has not let Claude run loose in its biology lab. Humans are still, so far, in the loop.

stories.title: 体验评测：Meta 的 Muse 智能体很可爱，也很会花我的钱
stories.sourceTitle: Meta’s AI agent is a cute little guy who’s great at spending my money
stories.summary: The Verge 记者以日常琐事为切入点，讲述自己的待办清单如何被不断自动生成，并实测 Meta 的 AI 智能体在处理这些事务时的表现与代价。
stories.analysis: “会花我的钱”这句话点出了代理型 AI 最现实的门槛：能力越强，授权和预算控制就越关键。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Modern life comes with an unending, auto-populating to-do list. It never ceases to amaze me how I can be doing nothing at all, minding my own business, and suddenly something needs to be taken care of. You're telling me a tree branch fell in the backyard and n

stories.title: Enveda 融资 3.11 亿美元，把天然来源的 AI 药物推进临床试验
stories.sourceTitle: Enveda secures $311M to bring more nature-derived AI drugs into clinical trials
stories.summary: AI 生物技术公司 Enveda 完成 3.11 亿美元融资，估值达 20 亿美元。公司目前正在测试用于治疗皮肤疾病、以及在停用 GLP-1 类药物后维持减重效果的药物。
stories.analysis: 以天然产物库结合 AI 筛选是一条差异化路线，而 GLP-1 停药后维持体重正是当下最热的未满足需求。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The round valued the AI biotech at $2 billion. It is currently testing drugs that treat skin conditions and preserve weight loss after stopping GLP-1s.

stories.title: Google Beam 扩展至五个新国家，新增合作伙伴与客户
stories.sourceTitle: Google Beam expands with new regions, partners, and customers
stories.summary: Google 宣布把 Google Beam 扩展到五个新国家，并与 Industrious 合作拓展网络覆盖，同时公布新的合作伙伴与客户。
stories.analysis: 企业级 AI 产品的竞争越来越依赖渠道与办公场景伙伴，而不是单纯的模型能力。
stories.sourceExcerpt: We’re expanding Google Beam to five new countries, and partnering with Industrious for an extended network.

stories.title: OpenAI 将 Daybreak 网络安全项目扩展至乌克兰政府
stories.sourceTitle: OpenAI extends cyber access to Ukraine for civilian defense
stories.summary: OpenAI 宣布把 Daybreak 项目的访问权限扩展给乌克兰政府，用于支持民用关键基础设施的网络防御。
stories.analysis: 这是前沿模型公司直接参与国家级网络防御的又一案例，也把模型访问权限变成了外交工具。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI is extending access to its Daybreak program to the Government of Ukraine to support the cyber defense of civilian infrastructure.

stories.title: ChatGPT 移动端上线语音代理功能，Pro 与 Plus 用户可手机执行任务
stories.sourceTitle: ChatGPT mobile app gets voice-based agentic features
stories.summary: ChatGPT 手机应用新增基于语音的智能体能力，Pro 和 Plus 用户可以在手机上的 Work 标签页中完成实际的代理型任务。
stories.analysis: 把智能体能力放进手机语音入口，意味着 OpenAI 正把桌面端的代理体验迁移到使用频率更高的场景。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Pro and Plus users will be able to use the Work tab on their phones to complete agentic tasks.

stories.title: 调查：即使每天使用 AI 的美国人，也同样对它感到担忧
stories.sourceTitle: Even Americans who use AI every day are worried about it
stories.summary: 一份报告显示，更高的 AI 使用频率并不会消解人们对该技术的焦虑，也没有削弱公众对 AI 监管的支持。
stories.analysis: “用得多”与“信得过”并不正相关，这为监管推动者提供了比恐慌叙事更扎实的依据。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The report suggests that greater exposure will not resolve the unease around the technology, nor reduce public support for AI regulation.

stories.title: OpenAI 发布 MentalHealthBench，评估 AI 在心理健康对话中的表现
stories.sourceTitle: Introducing MentalHealthBench
stories.summary: MentalHealthBench 是一个由专家参与设计的基准，用于评估 AI 在真实心理健康对话场景中给出的回答是否有帮助且安全。
stories.analysis: 心理健康是 AI 高风险应用之一，把评估标准公开化，也是在为后续产品边界预留解释空间。
stories.sourceExcerpt: MentalHealthBench is an expert-informed benchmark for evaluating helpful and safe AI responses across realistic mental health conversations.

stories.title: Sam Altman 在联合国安理会发言：谈 AI 安全、人类控制与国际合作
stories.sourceTitle: Sam Altman’s remarks at the United Nations Security Council
stories.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman 在联合国安理会发表讲话，讨论 AI 安全、人类对 AI 的控制以及国际协作等问题。
stories.analysis: 把 AI 治理搬到安理会层面，说明前沿实验室正试图在国家标准形成之前先塑造国际话语框架。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman discusses AI safety, human control, and international cooperation in remarks to the United Nations Security Council.

stories.title: YouTube Music 上线对话式 AI 功能 Ask Music
stories.sourceTitle: YouTube Music gets more conversational with new AI features
stories.summary: 新功能 Ask Music 内置于 YouTube Music 应用中，用户可以用日常语言描述想听什么，而不必再逐首搜索歌曲或歌手。
stories.analysis: 音乐推荐从“猜你喜欢”转向“听你说”，这会重塑歌单与推荐算法之间的关系。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Built directly into the YouTube Music app, Ask Music lets users describe what they want to hear in everyday language rather than searching for individual songs or artists.

stories.title: YouTube 推出自定义信息流：用 Gemini 按描述生成专属推荐
stories.sourceTitle: YouTube will let you build your own algorithm with AI
stories.summary: YouTube 的自定义 feed 允许用户用自己的话描述想看的内容，再由 Gemini 基于该需求构建个性化信息流。
stories.analysis: 让用户直接“写推荐算法”，是对平台推荐权的一次让渡，但底层排序逻辑仍掌握在 YouTube 手里。
stories.sourceExcerpt: YouTube’s new custom feeds let users describe the videos they want to see in their own words, then use Gemini to build a personalized feed around the request.

stories.title: StrictlyVC 将亮相 TechCrunch Disrupt 2026，讨论 AI 重塑下的风投规则
stories.sourceTitle: StrictlyVC at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: Inside the changing rules of venture capital
stories.summary: StrictlyVC 将参与 TechCrunch Disrupt 2026，讨论 AI 如何改变风险投资格局。活动提供 Investor Pass，9 月 25 日晚 11:59（太平洋时间）前报名可省 200 美元。
stories.analysis: 一级市场的规则变化往往比产品发布更早预示行业拐点，这类讨论值得关注。
stories.sourceExcerpt: StrictlyVC joins TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 to discuss the changing VC landscape thanks to AI. Get your Investor Pass to join these exclusive sessions. Save $200 before September 25 at 11:59 p.m. PT.

stories.title: InfoQ：如何利用 AI 搭建内部开发者平台
stories.sourceTitle: 利用 AI 搭建内部开发者平台
stories.summary: InfoQ 中文发布内容，讨论企业如何借助 AI 构建内部开发者平台，属于面向工程团队的落地实践方向。
stories.analysis: 内部开发者平台是 AI 进入企业工程体系最容易被忽视但回报稳定的切口。
stories.sourceExcerpt: 点击查看原文>

stories.title: 汇智智能发布 Hellome：国内首个 FDE 直连智能体服务平台
stories.sourceTitle: 汇智智能发布Hellome：国内首个FDE直连智能体服务平台，把AI交付周期压进“周”
stories.summary: 量子位报道，汇智智能发布 Hellome，定位为国内首个 FDE 直连的智能体服务平台，主打把企业 AI 交付周期压缩到“周”级别。
stories.analysis: “交付周期按周计”如果成立，卖点不在模型本身，而在于把定制交付的边际成本降下来。
stories.sourceExcerpt: 企业AI服务迎来平台化交付时代

stories.title: Qwen 发布 Qwen3Guard：面向 token 流的实时安全护栏模型
stories.sourceTitle: Qwen3Guard: Real-time Safety for Your Token Stream
stories.summary: Qwen 团队推出 Qwen3Guard，这是 Qwen 系列中首个安全护栏模型，基于 Qwen3 基座专门针对安全分类进行微调，可对 token 流进行实时安全防护。
stories.analysis: 把安全模型做成可实时拦截 token 流的独立组件，说明开源模型生态开始把治理能力产品化。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Tech Report GitHub Hugging Face ModelScope DISCORD Introduction We are excited to introduce Qwen3Guard, the first safety guardrail model in the Qwen family. Built upon the powerful Qwen3 foundation models and fine-tuned specifically for safety classificatoin,
